entries.ERROR: legacy path supplied no bounded Technical checkpoints
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The recovery fixture inherited feature gates and the legacy Technical boundary from ambient settings; its three imported settings accessors were not pinned consistently.

entries.ERROR: environment.json disappeared before final report generation and masked the certification verdict
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The harness placed durable certification evidence under pytest-playwright's owned test-results directory and reread a mutable artifact instead of retaining the setup identity in memory.
entries.REMEDIATION: Isolate evidence under .qa_work unless an explicit report root is supplied, retain the immutable environment payload in the fixture, and rewrite the final environment artifact from that source.

entries.ERROR: lazy Fundamentals Liquidity/Penalty values were reported empty for all eight tickers
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The E2E comparator still searched the pre-remediation labels Liquidity and Penalty; the certified score-card view names them Liquidity Risk and Missing Penalty.
entries.REMEDIATION: Compare the lazy score-card fragment through its authoritative labels after explicitly loading each detail row.

entries.ERROR: runtime observer reported a PostgreSQL transaction older than 120 seconds during sequential Technical scoring
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The clean-worktree E2E environment silently used default sequential Technical settings instead of the certified production process-pool and pure-boundary profile.
entries.REMEDIATION: Pin the production Technical process-pool, pure-boundary, and shadow-compare settings explicitly in the isolated certification runtime; retain the unchanged transaction-age observer.

entries.ERROR: FULL_PIPELINE progress_sequence stayed frozen at claim while stages advanced, causing the production watchdog to fence and replay the root job
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The deterministic certification adapter replaced the production FULL_PIPELINE handler to inject read-only IB dependencies but omitted its detached progress/cancellation callback contract and execution identity.
entries.REMEDIATION: Mirror the production control-plane boundary in the adapter with independent progress/cancellation transactions, pass the execution token and job ID, and assert both FULL_PIPELINE jobs advance without stalls or recovery.

entries.ERROR: Production runtime observer detected idle PostgreSQL transactions older than 120 seconds during transition reconstruction, Setup reconstruction, Technical calculation, and Technical evidence publication.
entries.ROOT CAUSE: Long read/CPU phases retained the pipeline ORM transaction; transition verification locked authority rows before reconstruction; independently recomputable Technical artifacts were retained with calculation state; and the atomic Technical evidence cohort opened two nested semantic savepoints per ticker.
entries.REMEDIATION: Close only clean outer read transactions at bounded checkpoints, reconstruct transition evidence before locking and revalidate the complete authority-row signature under lock, commit independent Technical artifact batches, defer the semantic writer transaction until publication, and publish the evidence cohort under one authority-validated savepoint.

entries.ERROR: Production runtime observer detected the Ranking writer retaining one transaction across all profiles and 500 evidence publications.
entries.ROOT CAUSE: Ranking calculation, declaration, and publication were owned by one outer transaction even though each profile is independently authoritative.
entries.REMEDIATION: Persist each profile through the canonical Ranking batch writer and commit only after each authority-validated profile publication.

entries.ERROR: Production runtime observer detected long Setup capture and lifecycle evaluation transactions across the 100-member population.
entries.ROOT CAUSE: Read/reconstruction phases and independently completed mutation batches shared one long outer pipeline transaction.
entries.REMEDIATION: Release clean read transactions before mutation and commit only after explicit evidence, reconciliation, lifecycle, primary-status, and transition batch checkpoints.

entries.ERROR: Production runtime observer detected Winner capture retaining the parent read transaction across the full ticker population.
entries.ROOT CAUSE: Per-ticker authority writes were isolated, but the parent session kept its read snapshot open between tickers.
entries.REMEDIATION: Release the clean parent read transaction after each fully published ticker while preserving the immutable source pins and child writer transaction.

entries.ERROR: Production runtime observer detected COMBINING_RESULTS exceeding 120 seconds while publishing one 100-member cohort.
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The Combined writer held calculation inputs and all evidence publication in one outer transaction despite independently authoritative ticker outputs.
entries.REMEDIATION: Bulk-load frozen inputs, persist ten-ticker Combined batches through the canonical writer, and commit after each authority-validated batch.

entries.ERROR: Production runtime observer detected SECTOR_ROTATION_SNAPSHOT persistence validation exceeding 120 seconds after validating 726 sources.
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The atomic Sector snapshot repeated per-ranking evidence loads, row-lock queries, and configuration-anchor reads after the bulk manifest check, while inheriting an earlier read transaction.
entries.REMEDIATION: Release the clean pre-writer read transaction, bulk-load evidence, bulk-lock Ranking rows, and cache configuration validation inside the unchanged single atomic Sector snapshot writer.

entries.ERROR: The canonical bounded Technical, Combined, and Ranking writers were discovered as unknown or unowned sinks after the high-cardinality transaction remediation.
entries.ROOT CAUSE: The executable architecture registry was updated with the new transaction sites, but T14A still named the former orchestration functions as canonical semantic writers.
entries.REMEDIATION: Map each bounded writer to its exact table and existing semantic family, retain the Technical source-manifest writer as a reviewed supporting member, and extend stale-source accounting for the changed Combined and Ranking sources.
